subject.title: UX: clarify provider-switcher layout with Agent Sessions enabled

question: Should many-provider navigation retain the responsive compact grid, or should CodexBar adopt a different bounded layout such as overflow, favorites, a picker, or a user preference?
rationale: Current behavior is intentional and tested, and each alternative changes navigation, AppKit interaction, or settings policy; source inspection cannot determine the preferred UX contract.

options.title: Retain responsive grid
options.body: Keep the existing tested layout as the default and consider only a narrow vertical-footprint or explanatory polish change.

options.title: Adopt bounded overflow
options.body: Replace excess rows with favorites, an overflow menu, or a picker while preserving direct access to all enabled providers.

options.title: Add a layout preference
options.body: Let users select grid or single-row behavior, accepting additional settings, persistence, documentation, and upgrade-test surface.

recommendation.title: Retain responsive grid
recommendation.body: Keep the existing tested layout as the default and consider only a narrow vertical-footprint or explanatory polish change.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior compact-grid change was merged under their review, and this issue asks for product direction on that same established UI behavior.
